title: Tensor-Train Compressed Separable PINNs: A Curvature-Aware Optimization Framework for Parametric PDEs in High Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2609.36165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we develop a second-order optimization framework for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) applied to high-dimensional parametric partial differential equations (PDEs). The framework is built on the Gauss--Newton pullback metric, which provides an operator-informed notion of curvature in parameter space and connects the method to the broader family of natural gradient schemes. We show that, for coordinate-separable neural architectures and linear differential operators (or linearized operators in the nonlinear case) admitting a finite separable representation, the residual Jacobian inherits a structured separable factorization. This yields an exact compressed formulation of the Gauss--Newton step in a reduced space, without assembling the full residual Jacobian on the exponentially large tensor-product collocation grid. translated_title: 张量列车压缩可分离PINNs：面向高维参数化偏微分方程的曲率感知优化框架
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们为应用于高维参数化偏微分方程（PDEs）的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）开发了一个二阶优化框架。该框架建立在Gauss-Newton回拉度量之上，该度量在参数空间中提供了一种算子信息引导的曲率概念，并将该方法与更广泛的自然梯度方案族联系起来。我们证明，对于坐标可分离的神经架构，以及允许有限可分离表示的线性微分算子（非线性情形下为线性化算子），残差雅可比矩阵继承了结构化的可分离分解。这产生了一个在约化空间中Gauss-Newton步的精确压缩公式，而无需在指数级大的张量积配点网格上组装完整的残差雅可比矩阵。约化空间的维数（即有效压缩维数）由局部……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于Gauss-Newton回拉度量的二阶优化框架，利用可分离PINN残差雅可比的结构化可分离分解实现张量列车式精确压缩，从而避免在指数级大的张量积配点网格上组装完整雅可比，高效求解高维参数化偏微分方程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a curvature-aware second-order optimization framework for PINNs based on the Gauss-Newton pullback metric, exploiting structured separable factorization of the residual Jacobian to obtain an exact compressed Gauss-Newton step via tensor-train compression, thereby solving high-dimensional parametric PDEs without assembling the full Jacobian on exponentially large tensor-product collocation grids.
